newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,772 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,772 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 1,772 contracts, compared with 529 contracts traded overnight Sunday.
There were 57 wheat, 1,346 corn, 152 soybean, 68 soymeal, 141 soyoil, seven oat and one corn put traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 to one cent lower, corn was one to 2-1/4 cents lower, soybeans one to three cents higher, soyoil 0.09 cent per lb higher and soymeal $1.40 per ton higher.
